crossover_note: crossover is measured in replay WORK (events per NPC): replay cost grows linearly with density x duration while synthesis is flat per NPC. In this workload the routine lane is closed-form derivable, so the present-state cost crossover is very low and replay's justification is capability (intermediate trajectory, robustness to non-derivable history — see the noisy-mode R5 result), not present-state cost. Evidence for policy, not a policy selection.

demo_long_quiet_vs_short_busy.note: 90 dormant days of QUIET history cost more to replay than 7 busy days — the crossover lives in event work, not elapsed time; an elapsed-time rule would have chosen wrong

determinism.note: sha256 of canonical logical-state results compared across two full in-process scenario runs; timings and memory excluded and NOT bit-identical

meta.adaptive_threshold_note: labeled assumption for the adaptive candidate — NOT a launch policy; the measured crossover is reported as evidence
